genius.notes: BENJI represents shares of the SEC-registered Franklin OnChain U.S. Government Money Fund. The issuer-associated legal entity is Franklin Templeton Trust, identified by SEC EDGAR registrant metadata and its fund filings; the transfer agent is not substituted for the investment company. Public withdrawal API instructions burn fund shares and remit proceeds, but do not establish a guaranteed 1:1 monetary redemption policy; redemptionPolicyPresent remains false under the tracker definition. Reserve and monthly-attestation flags remain false in the payment-stablecoin sense; ordinary fund portfolio filings are not GENIUS reserve attestations. Targeted SEC-domain searches did not locate an enforcement action naming this fund or trust as respondent. The fund is quarantined, so the absent MiCA row remains absent under sweep coverage rules.

applicabilityBasis.summary: Franklin states that each BENJI token represents one share of the SEC-registered Franklin OnChain U.S. Government Money Fund (FOBXX). SEC EDGAR identifies Franklin Templeton Trust as the registered investment company. Securities are expressly excluded from the GENIUS payment-stablecoin definition by section 2(22)(B)(iii); a money-fund stable NAV does not turn its shares into payment stablecoins.
